ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #5
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   C. Apply the teaching of Stories of Prophets: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Hiding stolen items

9. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

10. Which response best shows understanding of Twahara? (1 mark)

   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour
